initial_full_staged_whitespace_check_fai.cause: Original npm run verify stdout includes a trailing blank line; full raw stream must not be trimmed to satisfy Git whitespace checks

separate_nonraw_whitespace_check.command_projection: git -c core.fileMode=false diff --cached --check -- . followed by one :(exclude,literal)<path> for each of the original manifest's 17 exact raw .log paths
separate_nonraw_whitespace_check.interpretation: Only nonraw code/document whitespace check; does not replace or erase original full-check failure

final_index.purpose: Authoritative full final directory index, adding only this staging ledger and the final index to the first immutable 45-file stage
